what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Vanuatu, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters fell from 64067 in 2020 to 2336 in 2024.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Vanuatu list earthquakes.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Vanuatu.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2020.
IDMC's data for Vanuatu starts in 2011.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 3088 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Vanuatu.
